name: fetch
description: Download a video from a URL (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, etc.) using yt-dlp

output.description: Path to downloaded file, or JSON {paths:[...]} for multi-video downloads. With meta, always JSON {paths:[...], videos:[{id, path, url, title, description, view_count, like_count, comment_count, upload_date, duration}]}; a value the site did not return is null

params.name: url
params.description: URL to download (video page, profile, or playlist)

params.name: out
params.description: Output directory or file path. Defaults to current directory.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of videos to download from a playlist or channel

params.name: meta
params.description: Also return each video's id, title, caption text, views, likes, comments, upload date and duration as JSON
